train_concap_main: run the main training loop for ViLBert Conceptual Caption pre-training with configurable hyperparameters
create_dataset_conceptcap: create ConceptCapLoaderTrain and ConceptCapLoaderVal datasets from Conceptual Caption corpus with BERT tokenization
build_model_vilbert: build a BertForMultiModalPreTraining model with BertConfig for multi-modal pre-training on image-caption pairs
configure_optimizer_adamw: configure AdamW optimizer with weight decay, learning rate scheduling, and optional fp16 mixed precision support
resume_training_checkpoint: resume training from a saved checkpoint restoring model weights, optimizer state, and scheduler state
